things were just as bad as we feared. The droids had us outgunned, outmaneuvered and outmanned by a five-to-one margin. What none of us had counted on was the Wookiees. We'd all heard the stories of course, but we'd never fought next to them, never seen them rip apart a droid with their bare hands. They were magnificent. Even so it was still a suicide mission, at least it was until Master Yoda arrived. Then it became a battle; a winnable battle.|Retired 501st Clone Trooper|}} The '''Battle of Kashyyyk''', also known as the '''First Battle of Kashyyyk'''{{CSWECite|III|322|Wawaatt Archipelago}} and as the '''Battle of Kachirho''', was a prolonged campaign against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that took place during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] and was among the final conflicts of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] that had been invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] hoping to claim the Kashyyyk [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] junction, as well as gain information on secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] rumored to be in Wookiee archives, that could turn the war in its favor. In the course of the battle, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] turned their weapons on their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]], though the Wookiees helped many Jedi escape. During the [[Declaration of a New Order|proclaimed]] transformation of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], confused fighting as part of an Imperial crackdown on the Wookiees followed. Kashyyyk would be [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|totally subjugated]] by the Empire several weeks later and endured a prolonged period of [[Enslavement of Kashyyyk/Legends|occupation]] until it was at last [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|My decision…? War against the invaders!|King Grakchawwaa in response to Confederate leader [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]|}} [[File:Probes_Kashyyyk.jpg|thumb|left|260|CIS probe droids race towards Kashyyyk.]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was a major navigation hub for the eastern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], sitting at a nexus of the lateral [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] linking the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], as well as dominating the ancient routes running from [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] towards the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] had secured the major [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroutes]] to the north and south, so the Kashyyyk hyperlanes, though slower than the main routes, represented the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems']] best chance of outflanking the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] or penetrating the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Additionally, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] had long been rumored to possess knowledge of secret hyperspace routes; the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]], based out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], had a long tradition of training hyperspace [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], and both Republic and Separatist intelligence agencies were determined to claim their archives. Furthermore, Kashyyyk had long been considered a model of Republic influence in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], with the Wookiees being representatives of the Republic in the otherwise-dangerous [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] and on the edge of Hutt Space. The Separatist movement considered the Wookiees politically embarrassing. Therefore, Kashyyyk was a strategically important system which had long been a target for the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]]. Confederate leaders requested the Wookiees join their rebellion, but the [[Kashyyyk Royal Families]] proved indecisive. Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], frustrated over the Wookiees' delay, decided to send Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to Kashyyyk to force the issue. The droids accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Rikummee]], who was out hunting, and an enraged [[King/Legends|King]] [[Grakchawwaa/Legends|Grakchawwaa]] decided to oppose the Separatists. After a number of probing attacks throughout the war, the Separatists finally decided on a full-scale invasion of the city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] in the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]]. This was to serve as a literal beachhead into the rest of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]]-covered planet. To this end, the Separatists made particular use of the age-old hostility between the native Wookiees and their [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|system]] neighbors, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], to prepare for their attack. The Trandoshans already had [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps on Kashyyyk where they held Wookiees captive. After it was [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|discovered]] that Trandoshan slavers had an agreement with the CIS, it was known that Trandoshans might fight for the Separatists in an upcoming battle.
[[File:Tarkov_Sees_Sep_Army.jpg|thumb|260|Jaccoba and Tarkov watch as the Separatists invade the planet.]]
Eventually, the Separatists landed a large droid force in secret and prepared for an invasion. A Wookiee woodsmith, [[Tarkov]], on a [[grantaloupe]] hunt with his son [[Jaccoba]], discovered the invasion force and warned the nearest township, [[Kahiyuk/Legends|Kahiyuk]]. From there, the alarm clarions spread the word of invasion to the other archipelago cities of [[Warralokk/Legends|Warralokk]], [[Grunnrurr/Legends|Grunnrurr]], and [[Rowrakruk/Legends|Rowrakruk]]. The Wookiees prepared for war. However, while the system was an important strategic location and both sides believed the battle to be straightforward, the battle was, in fact, little more than a diversion by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. ==The battle== ===Initial actions=== {{Quote|Many ships ring this planet, Master Unduli. Many. Numbers they have, but the Force is with us. A plan I have, but move quickly we must. The enemy marches.|Jedi Grand Master Yoda, upon arrival to Kashyyyk|}} The battle began with a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist fleet]] deployed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Kashyyyk and a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] deployed to occupy the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]], establishing a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] perimeter as protection against a counterattack. General Grievous selected the nearby city of Kachirho as his bridgehead. Kashyyyk was largely covered by dense [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr]] [[Forest/Legends|forest]] that provided good defensive cover, but at Kachirho, the shallow open waters of the [[Wartaki Sea/Legends|Wartaki Sea]] offered a good approach for an amphibious landing, and the lines of communication into the interior were excellent. In preparation for the assault on Kachirho, the Separatists deployed large numbers of [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]] and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 tank droids]], with considerable [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] support from [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. The complex terrain made more-conventional [[Armor/Legends|armor]] like the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] or the Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] unusable. The massive [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Trade Federation cruisers]] around the planet blocked any reinforcements to relieve the beleaguered garrison on the surface. The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were dispatched to cut a path through the [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Destroying the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] defenses, the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] focused all firepower on the nearest [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. Using a high-altitude [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] gunship, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] formed a boarding party and sabotaged the inside of the ship, destroying the command [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], [[Life support/Legends|life-support]], and [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. They came across a battle-plan [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which contained the Separatist's strategies for the [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground battle]], and delivered it safely back to their [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. With a path cut through the blockade, the Republic's reinforcements touched down on the planet. ===Delta Squad's mission=== {{Main|Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)}} The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], led by [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], infiltrated a Trandoshan [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] camp in order to rescue the Wookiee [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]]. The [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] successfully rescued Tarfful from several of General Grievous's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]], as well as obtaining intelligence about the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] alliance with the Trandoshan mercenaries. Delta Squad also discovered the number of hostiles on Kashyyyk was higher than the [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]] had previously thought. The squad then sabotaged the Trandoshans' outpost on Kashyyyk, destroying two of their landing pads. When the Confederacy launched their full-scale invasion of the Wookiee [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], Delta Squad was the only [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] unit planetside capable of assisting in the defense. Delta Squad sabotaged a [[Kachirho Bridge|bridge connecting the two sides of Kachirho]], stopping the Confederacy's advance. The commandos also secured vital munitions and ordnance depots for the Wookiees, allowing them to sufficiently arm themselves to fight against the Confederacy. Their final operation was the destruction of a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] attempting to land more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] onto the surface. Following this, [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], the team's [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] specialist, was lost and presumed MIA, but orders that came directly from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] forced Delta Squad to abandon Sev. Delta Squad was then extracted and redeployed as the Republic invasion force arrived, and the Battle of Kashyyyk was joined. ===Massing at Kachirho=== Meanwhile, Wookiees from across Kashyyyk flocked to Kachirho. Among these brave Wookiees was [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], an old friend of Kachriho's chieftain, Tarfful, who feared greatly that Kashyyyk would be unable to defend itself against the might of Separatist forces. Led by [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]], [[Wookiee warrior/Legends|Wookiee warriors]] established positions deep in entrenchments and revetments. These forces, on the ground and in the [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft/Legends|ornithopters]] and [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Wookiee catamarans]], included [[Salporin/Legends|Salporin]], [[Eugroothwa/Legends|Eugroothwa]], [[Zittaasabba/Legends|Zittaasabba]], [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], [[Guanta/Legends|Guanta]], [[Gorrlyn]], and [[Lachichuk/Legends|Lachichuk]]. The Wookiee defense of Kachirho was reinforced by a Republic vanguard led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]], and included a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commandos, and the [[7th Aleena Reconnaissance Regiment]] led by the Jedi Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], who collected intelligence on enemy maneuvers prior to the battle on flying [[Can-cell/Legends|Can-cells]]. Other elements were led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], soon followed by [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]].[[Republic 81|''Republic'' 81]] Unduli and Vos, as well as Wookiees led by [[Gumbaeki]], Guildmaster of the [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]] and an elder from the [[Palsaang/Legends|Palsaang]] tribe, infiltrated an encampment of Trandoshans using the Separatist raiding party as an excuse to capture and enslave Wookiees. Destroying the encampment and freeing the hairy simians was a simple matter, but a [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droid]] ambushed the group shortly afterward and was subsequently destroyed by the [[Inferno (Vilmarh Grahrk)|''Inferno'']], a ship belonging to the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] smuggler [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], who'd had previous relationships with General Vos. Vilmarh, or "Villie," alongside his young Wookiee friend, Gumbaeki's grandson, [[Chak (Wookiee)|Chak]], had apparently recently been smuggling goods to Palsaang. The Separatists' true intentions in invading Kashyyyk were revealed when a dying Trandoshan, [[Karniss]], revealed that the CIS came in search of the hidden Claatuvac [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes that would give them much strategic advantage. Quinlan soon discovered these routes had fallen into the hands of Vilmarh, with some assistance from Chak, whose grandfather was a member of the Claatuvac Guild.[[Republic 82|''Republic'' 82]] After arriving through the dangerous Kashyyyk orbit (due to surrounding Separatist space forces) with Chieftain Tarfful from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Yoda, who'd maintained good relations with the Wookiees in previous Trandoshan incidents (and earned the title "[[Defender of the Home Tree/Legends|Defender of the Home Tree]]"), was informed of these routes. Consequently, Yoda revised the Republic defensive plan. Commander Faie had planned to disrupt and harass Separatist troops in a mobile defensive campaign. Instead, Yoda decided that the Separatists had to be stopped right outside Kachirho, a change of tactics that meant heavier casualties and necessitated the deployment of a larger [[Army/Legends|army]] under Jedi command. ===Yoda's battle plan=== {{Quote|The droids have started up their main power generators.''"
"''Then now, the time is, Commander.|Clone Commander Gree and Yoda||audio=Linwodo.flac}} [[File:WookieeCharge-ROTS.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] defend their homeworld from invading Separatist forces.]] From Coruscant, Yoda had brought the crack battalions of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]]—generally regarded as the best [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Army]]—led by clone [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], and a full assault [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] from the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]]. Yoda planned to conduct a static defense and hold the Separatists right outside the walls of Kachirho. The 41st Elite reinforced Kachirho just before the Separatists attacked. After receiving a transmission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] concerning the discovery of Separatist General Grievous on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], Yoda went into [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] as the Separatist [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] was lowered. Separatist forces rushed across the lagoon at speed in a simple wave attack, with armor and [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] storming Kachirho's beaches and sea walls with large numbers of droid infantry in support. [[File:SepKashyyykForces.png|thumb|right|250px|Separatist forces press the attack during the battle.]] Merumeru's Wookiee forces rushed across the beachfront to confront the enemy as more warriors swung from the cliffs along the archipelago to place [[Mine/Legends|mines]] on the combustible droid forces. Meanwhile, clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] fired from trenches, and [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooters]] sniped out enemies from the branches of Tree Kachirho. On the vehicle front, Wookiee Oevvaor jet catamarans were aided by the Republic's [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernauts]], [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]] and [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and other assault vehicles. They faced opposition from Separatist [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 droid tanks]], [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] and [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platforms]]. The job of the 41st Elite and detachments of the 501st Legion, supported by Wookiees, was to fight on the beachfront defending the sea wall and to hold the line until Separatist forces were fully committed. When this occurred, Yoda gave the word to Master Unduli to counter-charge the droid army on its left flank with the 41st Elite. Simultaneously, Quinlan Vos, alongside Chewbacca and Tarfful, was sent across the lagoon to lead an attack on approaching Separatist forces, but Villie still felt it necessary to join the action, a decision that led to the destruction of the ''Inferno'' by an enemy gunship. Vos, Villie and Chak were immediately sent to a Juggernaut to recuperate. ===Beaten back=== {{Quote|This is it, men. We have to hold this beach head until reinforcements arrive. No retreats. No excuses.|Command issued to all 501st clone troopers at the start of the battle|}} [[File:BoK-ROTS.png|thumb|left|200px|Clone troopers fire down on the advancing CIS forces.]] The battle seemed to go back and forth until, despite the best efforts of the combined Wookiee/Republic defense, Kachirho was in danger of being overrun by the Separatists. The 501st Legion had been beaten back by Separatist forces, which were advancing on the Kachirho sea wall and attempting to destroy a crucial energy refinery. Defending the sea wall from atop it were two concussion turrets and multiple clone troopers. However, few attempts from the CIS to destroy the sea wall were made from the Wookiee refinery, and eventually the tide of the battle turned in favor of the Republic. The best efforts of [[clone engineer]]s and [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130S fighter tanks]] managed to keep the sea wall intact until Master Yoda could arrive to push the CIS back. With the foiling of this crucial mission, the droid army began to retreat from the refinery, and the surrounding beaches were recaptured. Despite this success, Republic forces suffered heavy casualties. The decision to meet the droid army in the shallows meant that Republic Juggernaut armor and AT-AP [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] could not be deployed until Separatist forces had come ashore at the cost of heavy infantry casualties on the beachfront. ===Order 66=== {{Quote|It will be done, my Lord.|Clone Commander Gree to Darth Sidious|}} [[File:TheDeathofCommanderGree.png|thumb|right|230px|Yoda kills Commander Gree.]] Suddenly, Master Yoda was shocked by a strong disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was carried out throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] received a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] call on a [[004|frequency-locked channel]] reserved for the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, alias the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, instructed him to execute Order 66 against General Yoda. A [[Unidentified clone scout trooper|41st trooper]] joined Gree and attempted to assassinate Yoda. As the clones prepared to execute him, Yoda drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], sensing what was about to happen, and in one fell swoop decapitated his would-be [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Yoda then escaped into the nearby [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] along with Wookiee warriors Tarfful and Chewbacca, after fighting through swarms of clone troopers. Their quick escape was fortunate, as a minute later, a [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernaut]] fired at Yoda's command post in a meeting hall, obliterating it. Outside, the battle between Republic and Separatist forces was slowing down: Wookiees stacked wrecked droids while clone troopers assessed the damage to their equipment. Jedi Master Luminara Unduli was conferring with eight clone troopers on the transportation of wounded soldiers back to medships when Order 66 was executed and she was pelted with blaster fire from all directions. Jedi Master Quinlan Vos was reflecting on his decision to leave the Order for his love, [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]], when he was suddenly shot by the laser cannon of a nearby Juggernaut, under command of Commander Faie, who'd just received Order 66. Quinlan survived, although severely burned, and vengefully slew all the 41st Elite Corps troopers under Faie's command who were searching for him. Eventually, he ran into Faie and killed him, but not without suffering dire wounds from his [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]. Cleverly, Vilmarh Grahrk found him and burned Faie's body, then tricked the clone troopers into thinking it was Quinlan's. After nursing him back to good health in a bacta tank, Vilmarh and Quinlan would return eight months later, where the Jedi would reunite with Khaleen and meet his new son, [[Korto Vos]].[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]] In the confusion surrounding Order 66, the droid army managed one last effort and broke the lines at Kachirho although the clone army was able to hold them back.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] Yoda, with Tarfful and Chewbacca, escaped into the nearby mountains, evading clone patrols. Later that evening, Chewbacca and Tarfful brought Yoda to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. After exchanging farewells, Yoda left the planet in the pod, and the two Wookiees went to rejoin their fellows. By this time, the droid army was slowly losing the war and was ultimately shut down by Sidious' new apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] who at the behest of his master also killed the Separatist council on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], ending the war. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Even so, Tinny got his revenge, because the Jedi got the Wookiees to revolt, and Mytaranor became a real kriffstorm.|Commander [[Gett]], [[41st Stormtrooper Legion]], [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]|}} With the fighting ceasing, AT-RT squads were deployed to patrol Kachirho. Due to the Wookiees' support the Jedi when Order 66 was issued, the Empire enforced a crackdown, with it taking several days of confusion to restore order in the city. The commando [[Triton Squad]] then began killing fugitive Wookiees throughout the forest before the Empire pulled out. Ultimately, the forces of the Galactic Empire left Kashyyyk empty-handed: after investigating the vault of the Claatuvac Guild in [[Tree Vikkilynn/Legends|Tree Vikkilynn]] in Kachirho, they found the Guild's data stacks wiped clean of information. Some twelve of the Guild's most trusted scouts had fled with the navigational data encrypted in [[HoloGrid/Legends|HoloGrids]], and it would not be until nearly twenty years later that one came to light in the hands of Chewbacca.''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' Soon after the Clone Wars ended, the Wookiees to begin salvaging the masses of wrecked military hardware that the battle had left strewn across their world. Ironically, the Wookiees put this equipment to good use against Imperial forces several weeks later: the Empire, led by Darth Vader, returned to and [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|occupied]] Kashyyyk mere weeks later when it was discovered the Wookiees were harboring fugitive Jedi led by [[Roan Shryne]] and [[Olee Starstone]]. Kashyyyk was subjected to [[Enslavement of Kashyyyk/Legends|enslavement]] thereafter by the Empire, with many millions of Wookiee slaves used in the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. However, resistance on Kashyyyk continued for years afterwards, with Jedi Master [[Kento Marek]] leading a [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|battle]] around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' and the Empire was still conducting pacification operations as late as [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The Separatists have launched a desperate attack on the Wookiee homeworld. We cannot allow this planet to fall into Separatist hands. Defend Kashyyyk and drive the enemy off the planet.|Yoda briefing the player before the mission|}} [[File:SWRofB_Battle_of_Kashyyyk.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The two armies fight to the last brick.]] A climactic battle between the technologically advanced Empire and a race of primitive hairy aliens, the Wookiees, was present in [[George Lucas]]'s original treatment for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. As the story changed and the trilogy structure was solidified in Lucas' mind, the battle was postponed until [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], where it developed into a battle featuring [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. At the same time, the Wookiees developed into a more technologically savvy, though not less hairy, species. Lucas' original conception of the battle featured hundreds of Wookiees on screen. Due to costs, the original idea was scrapped and replaced by a battle featuring relatively few diminutive Ewoks, who did not play a very significant tactical role in the battle. A large-scale battle with hundreds of characters was eventually realized in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. The first depiction of this battle appeared in the 2004 video game ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'' as the last level in the game's ''Clone Wars Campaign''. At the time of the game's release, [[LucasArts]] did not want any Episode III content to be revealed very early, therefore the game's depiction of the battle features clone troopers in [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase I armor]] despite the fact that most clone troopers (besides the [[01/425|clone advisor]] in ''Republic Commando'') would have already switched to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|phase II armor]] by the time this battle occurred. The fight was parodied in [[The LEGO Group|LEGO]]'s [[LEGO Star Wars: Revenge of the Brick|''Revenge of the Brick'']] spoof of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'', an alliance of sorts between the clones and droids is depicted following the execution of Order 66.
